title: Submission review report
markdown:
# Submission review report

_Change Management - Rev 2.xer (data date 16 Nov 2026) against Change Management - Rev 1.xer (17 Aug 2026)_

## Recommendation

**Return for revision.** 2 high-severity findings to put right before the programme can be relied on.

Findings: 2 high, 2 medium, 2 low.

## Completion

Forecast completion 13 May 2027 last time, 17 Jun 2027 now: 35 calendar days later.

## Float erosion

- Float rose on 2 (50 days in all).
- Completion moved 25 working days later (35 calendar days): the critical path's float did not absorb the delay.
- Total float is measured to the forecast completion, which moved with the delay, so float alone does not show it: the critical path still reads 0 days. Judge the delay by the completion movement and the Key Dates (Variance).

## Comments for the contractor

- **R01 (high) 2 milestones forecast later than last month.** Key dates and milestones that moved later. _Action:_ Explain each movement and its effect on the Key Dates and Completion.
- **R02 (high) The forecast completion has moved 35 calendar days later.** 2027-05-13 last month, 2027-06-17 now (25.0 working days). _Action:_ Explain the delay - its cause and the critical path through it - and the measures to recover it.
- **R03 (medium) 2 schedule checks now fail that passed last month.** Missed activities (27.3); Baseline Execution Index (BEI) (0.9). _Action:_ Put right the activities behind each check (see Schedule Health).
- **R04 (medium) 2 of 6 activities forecast to start this period did not.** 4 started (66.7%). _Action:_ Explain each missed start and confirm its revised start is achievable.
- **R05 (low) 1 activity forecast to finish this period did not.** 5 of 6 forecast finishes were achieved (83.3%). _Action:_ Explain the missed finishes.
- **R06 (low) The period covered is 91 days.** A monthly update covers about a month; this one covers 91 days (2026-08-17 to 2026-11-16). _Action:_ Confirm the reporting period agreed for updates.
